technical.summary: AMCR shows long-term bullish structure (EMA 50/200, Supertrend) but lacks short-term confirmation with weak momentum, no crossover signals, and price below key moving averages—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AMCR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 39 days creating near-term event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (226) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 39 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for materials exporter.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (EMA 50/200, Supertrend) combined with extreme market fear (35/100) and oversold conditions (RSI, Stochastic, Williams %R) create contrarian accumulation opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 226), no short-term momentum confirmation, price below critical moving averages (EMA 9/20), weak trend strength (ADX 20.97), and earnings event risk in 39 days make this a high-risk, low-probability entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme market fear and oversold technicals present contrarian appeal, the absence of short-term momentum confirmation, price below critical moving averages, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 39 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signals and VIX at crisis levels (226) could trigger sharp downside acceleration before any mean-reversion bounce materializes.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show contrarian opportunity, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose entry; debate decisively favors bear case.
